Source likely in theme or component using shadowColor/shadowOffset. Reference: any component using shadow* props (e.g. StyleSheet in booking/card components).

action_items: (Optional) Migrate deprecated React Native Web 'shadow*' style props to 'boxShadow' to silence console warning.
